name: Shuuchaku Gakuen
source:
Even if that love is the blade that tears apart the present...

"...Let's stay together forever. I want to play with you... for years and years..."
"...I won't ever let you go."

Those words sound familiar, like something someone told me long ago.
A mysterious school hidden deep in the mountains, far from the city.
There, only one thing mattered: whether or not you had a talent for twisted obsessive love.
As my days at school went by, my peaceful life turned into a blood-soaked nightmare...

[Translated from [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3236000/_/?l=japanese]Steam[/url]]
translation:
哪怕那爱是撕裂现在的利刃……

“……让我们永远在一起吧。我想和你一起玩……很多年……”
“……我永远不会放开你。”

这句话听起来很熟悉，就像很久以前有人告诉我的一样。
一所神秘的学校，隐藏在深山之中，远离城市。
在那里，只有一件事很重要：你是否有扭曲、痴迷的爱情的天赋。
随着我在学校的日子一天天过去，平静的生活变成了一场血淋淋的噩梦……

[译自[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3236000/_/?l=japanese]Steam[/url]]
